📰 Why Is PancakeSwap Forcing CAKE Holders to Withdraw Their Funds?

PancakeSwap announced that opBNB users must move their funds by November 23, because LayerZero has discontinued support for opBNB. This could bring major changes to how CAKE holders manage liquidity, and the future of its tokenomics may change along with it.

Why does this news matter?
The root of the issue is that the LayerZero and opBNB technology path has reached a dead end. opBNB was originally a fast bridge built by LayerZero on Arbitrum, but now that LayerZero no longer supports it, that route is gone for good. For PancakeSwap, which uses opBNB for liquidity, this means some users and funds are being forced out. Those who don’t move their funds risk losing their value. For CAKE holders, it means their token has suddenly lost an important liquidity outlet and a potential use case for appreciation.

Market impact
In the short term, this will undoubtedly intensify the stablecoin migration. CAKE holders may rush to find alternatives, such as moving to the BNB sidechains of Uniswap or SushiSwap. This could temporarily strain liquidity on those platforms and weigh on market sentiment toward CAKE. In the long term, however, if opBNB users choose to return to the mainnet, that could bring new competitive pressure to other protocols. More broadly, this exposes the fragility of bridge technologies like LayerZero: if one part fails, the entire ecosystem can be affected.

💡 Simply put, CAKE liquidity may move from opBNB to other chains, but it’s not yet clear where it will go. If users move their funds on a large scale, ETH liquidity on other protocols could benefit temporarily.

content:
📰 为什么 PancakeSwap 要逼 CAKE 持有者出金？

PancakeSwap 公告 opBNB 用户必须在 11 月 23 日前转走资金，因为 LayerZero 已停运 opBNB 支持。这对 CAKE 们的流动性管理可能得来个大变局，Tokenomics 的未来也可能跟着变。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事根本原因在于 LayerZero 和 opBNB 这条技术路线走到了死胡同。opBNB 本来是 LayerZero 搭在 Arbitrum 上的快捷桥，但现在 LayerZero 不支持了，这条路就彻底没了。对于用 opBNB 做流动性的 PancakeSwap 来说，这等于被强制淘汰一部分用户和资金，不转就得损失这部分价值。对 CAKE 持有者来说，这意味着手里的代币突然少了一个重要的流动性出口和潜在升值场景。

对市场的影响
短期看，这肯定会加剧稳定币的搬家潮。CAKE 持有者可能会急于找到替代方案，比如转到 Uniswap 或 SushiSwap 的 BNB 侧链上。这会暂时挤压那些平台的流动性，让 CAKE 市场情绪承压。但长期来看，如果 opBNB 用户选择回迁主网，可能会给其他协议带来新的竞争压力。更深层的影响是，这暴露了 LayerZero 这类桥接器技术路线的脆弱性——一旦某个环节出问题，整个生态都会受影响。

💡 简单说，这意味着 CAKE 流动性可能会从 opBNB 搬到其他链，但具体搬到哪还不确定。如果用户大规模转走，其他协议的 ETH 流动性可能会阶段性受益。

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place Your Stop-Loss? How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Too close, and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can hurt badly.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, and suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop may end up right where other people’s stops are clustered.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the market structure is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if price breaks this level, that’s evidence I was wrong.
Adjust position size accordingly: the wider the stop-loss distance, the smaller the position, to ensure the loss on any single trade remains a set percentage of the account

Binance futures liquidations totaled $19.43 million over the past 4 hours | Longs accounted for 93.1% | $ETH  ranked first
Before looking at positions, first understand liquidations.
A long liquidation means a leveraged long position is forcibly closed, usually when prices fall; a short liquidation is the opposite, and mostly happens when prices rise.
The commonly used term “long squeeze” refers to a drop triggering long liquidations, with the resulting sell orders pushing prices lower; a “short squeeze” is when a rise triggers short liquidations, and buybacks push prices even higher.
Learning to read indicators isn’t hard. The hard part is sticking to your plan when the market gets extremely volatile.

常说的「多杀多」说的是下跌引发多单强平、平仓卖单又压低价格；「逼空」则是上涨逼出空单强平、回补再推高价格。

After spending enough time in crypto, you’ll notice a pattern: the fancier the strategy, the faster you lose. #ETH 

People who spend all day studying this indicator and that trading setup often end up with the emptiest accounts.

I’ve seen far too many retail traders switch coins several times a day and cycle through one strategy after another. They say they’re “optimizing their strategy,” but really, they’re just messing around. The more they tinker, the faster they lose—and they still think they’re making progress.

After years of experimenting, I’ve settled on one simple model: one coin + follow the trend + trade the swings. Pick one major coin, trade only in the direction of the trend, and take each move as it comes. It’s not complicated, but it works.

Here are the basics:
First, trade only major coins. Just pick either BTC or ETH. Don’t chase AI coins today, MEME coins tomorrow, then run off to look at Dogecoin the day after. That’s not trading—it’s fan behavior. Stick with one coin, and over time you’ll naturally get a feel for its rhythm.

Second, only trade with the trend. Go long when it’s rising and short when it’s falling. Don’t try to catch bottoms, call tops, or bet on reversals. Follow the market wherever it goes. If it’s not moving, just wait. Challenging the trend with your limited judgment isn’t worth it.

Third, scale in and out. Start with a small position to test the waters, then add if things look right. Add another position at a key level. Take profits in batches as the price rises; don’t try to cash out all at once. Set your stop-loss in advance, and don’t stubbornly hold on.
I once coached a follower with a 6,000U account. They made three consecutive trend-following trades, stuck strictly to the rules, and made over 16,000U in three days. It wasn’t gambling—it was discipline plus structure.

This approach works for three reasons: focusing on just one coin means fewer distractions and more decisive trades; having a plan for entry and exit keeps emotions from throwing you off; and keeping losses small while letting profits run means you can make money over the long term even with an average win rate.

Of course, this approach isn’t for everyone. People who chase pumps and dumps, get carried away by their emotions, or want to go all-in and turn their lives around won’t be able to stick with it.

It’s only for people willing to follow the rules—people who aren’t looking to get rich overnight, but just want to take a steady approach.

content:
币圈待久了你会发现一条规律：策略越花哨，亏得越快。#ETH 

那些整天研究这指标那战法的人，账户往往最干净。

盈哥见过太多散户，一天换好几个币，换好几套打法，嘴里说着“优化策略”，其实就是瞎折腾。越折腾亏得越快，还觉得自己在进步。

我这些年折腾下来，最后就守住一个笨模型：单币种+顺势做+波段操作。锁定一个主流币，只顺着方向做，吃一段是一段。不复杂，但管用。

具体就这么几条：
第一，只做主流币。BTC和ETH二选一就行。别今天追AI，明天追MEME，后天又跑去看狗狗币。那不是交易，是追星。盯住一个，做久了，节奏自然就出来了。

第二，只做顺势。涨了就做多，跌了就做空。别抄底，别猜顶，别赌反转。市场往哪走，你就往哪跟。它不走，你就等着。别拿你那点判断去挑战趋势，不值当。

第三，分仓进出。先拿小仓位试，感觉对了再加。到了关键位置补一笔。涨上去分批卖，别想一口吃光。止损提前挂好，别扛。
之前带过一个粉丝，6000U的账户，连着做了三笔顺势单，严格按照规矩来，三天赚了16000多U。不是赌，就是纪律加结构。

这套方法能跑出来，就三个原因：只盯一个币，干扰少，出手果断；进场出场有预案，不被情绪带偏；亏小赚大，哪怕胜率一般，长期也能赚。

当然，这东西不是谁都适合。追涨杀跌的、情绪上头的、想一把梭哈翻身的，都玩不了。

它只属于那些愿意守规矩、不求暴富只求稳着来的人

What does a DEX aggregator do? Many people can’t answer!
An aggregator generally doesn’t provide liquidity itself; it only routes trades, calling on pools across different DEXs to execute swaps.
Individual pools have limited depth. Splitting a large swap across several pools means each pool experiences less price impact, often resulting in a better overall execution price.
If you’re unfamiliar with something, don’t rush into it. Start by practicing with a small amount.

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math Behind Going All-In—Will You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, with a 50% gain on a win and a 50% loss on a loss. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in every time, here’s the long-term expected return: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = +10% per trade,
which looks like a positive expectancy. But consider the path: two losses in a row means -75%, and you need a +300% gain to break even.
A positive-expectancy strategy + going all-in = a high probability of going bust. That’s the gambler’s ruin theorem
playing out every day in crypto.

Same strategy, but only use 20% of your position each time: two losses in a row means -18%—hardly a scratch.
You still capture the long-term expectancy. The strategy hasn’t changed; only your position size has—and that makes all the difference between survival and ruin.

📰 Why Did Bitcoin’s Price Fall After Galaxy Declared the Bear Market Over?

Galaxy released a report saying Bitcoin’s bear market ended in June, as long-term holders began selling, creating a buying opportunity. The source is The Block. These comments should have boosted market sentiment, but BTC continued to fall after the report was published. It is currently trading at $80,212, down 0.30% over the past 24 hours.

Why does this news matter?

Galaxy’s standing means its views can influence the market. As a top Bitcoin fund, its assessments are often seen as a barometer for the industry. This news matters because it signals an institutional reassessment of the current market cycle—from a bear market to a potential bull market.

More specifically, two deeper dynamics are worth noting. First, Galaxy’s conclusion is not without basis: its report says that “long-term holders are beginning to sell.” This means some early investors are taking profits, releasing coins that could form the basis for a market rebound. This is consistent with a typical late-stage bear market pattern: early investors exit in large numbers, paving the way for subsequent buying.

Second, in terms of industry cycles, Galaxy’s assessment aligns with recent expectations around the Bitcoin halving. A halving means reduced supply, while Galaxy’s buy signal suggests demand may be building. In theory, this shift in supply and demand should support higher prices.

But the muted market reaction—even a decline—suggests that reality is more complex than theoretical models. Why might upbeat institutional statements actually weaken the market? There are three possible reasons:
1. **The market had already priced in the news**: Bitcoin’s bear market has lasted two years, during which positive news has kept coming. Institutions signaling optimism in advance may be seen as offering nothing new.
2. **Selling pressure exceeded expectations**: The scale of “long-term holder selling” mentioned in Galaxy’s report may be far greater than the market expected, creating outflow pressure that outweighs buying demand.
3. **Macroeconomic risks are weighing on the market**: Even if Bitcoin’s bear market is over, the global macroeconomic environment remains uncertain. Factors such as U.S. inflation and expectations of interest rate hikes may lead investors to wait and see.

Impact on the market

In the short term, Galaxy’s bullish signal may provide more of a sentiment boost than a direct price catalyst. If the market continues to fall, it could mean that the institution was too optimistic about the scale of selling or macroeconomic risks.

Over the medium to long term, the news may affect capital flows. Institutions could encourage retail investors to enter the market through public statements, or validate their outlook through actual purchases rather than statements alone. Either approach could support prices. The key question is how long it will take for that support to be confirmed.

There are few comparable historical events. Before BTC began its first bull run in 2009, no institution had published a clear bullish report in advance. But the Bitcoin market has changed significantly: institutional investors are now a major force, and their statements carry far more influence than they used to.

Trading approach
💡 Based on current data, Galaxy’s bullish signal is more of a sentiment indicator than a direct price catalyst. If BTC falls below the previous support level of $78,000, that would suggest the market has not embraced the institutional signal, and the bullish thesis may need to be revised.

📰 为何 Galaxy 宣布比特币熊市结束时，价格反而下跌？

Galaxy 发布报告称比特币熊市已于 6 月结束，因长期持有者开始抛售释放了买入机会。消息来源是 The Block。这番言论本应提振市场情绪，但 BTC 在发布后却继续下跌，目前报价 $80,212，24 小时跌幅 0.30%。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Galaxy 的地位决定了其观点具有市场影响力。作为顶级比特币基金，其判断通常被视为行业风向标。这条新闻的重要性在于，它标志着机构层面对当前市场周期的一次重新评估——从熊市转为潜在牛市。

具体来说，有两个深层逻辑值得关注。第一，Galaxy 的结论并非空穴来风，其报告指出“长期持有者开始抛售”。这意味着部分早期获利者正在退出，释放的筹码构成了市场反弹的基础。这与传统熊市末期的特征一致：前期获利者集中离场，为后续买盘铺路。

第二，在行业周期上，Galaxy 的判断与近期比特币减半预期形成共振。减半意味着供应减少，而 Galaxy 的买入信号则暗示需求端可能正在积累力量。这种供需结构的变化，理论上应该支撑价格上行。

但市场反应平淡，甚至出现下跌，意味着现实情况比理论模型更复杂。为什么机构的高调看多反而让市场走弱？可能的原因有三：
1. **市场早已消化该信息**：比特币熊市持续时间长达两年，期间利好消息不断。机构提前释放看多信号，可能被视为缺乏新意。
2. **抛售压力超出预期**：Galaxy 报告中提到的“长期持有者抛售”，规模可能远超市场预期，导致资金流出压力大于买入需求。
3. **宏观风险压制**：尽管比特币熊市结束，但全球宏观环境依然不确定，例如美国通胀、加息预期等，可能让投资者选择观望。

对市场的影响
短期来看，Galaxy 的看多信号可能更多是情绪层面的支撑，而非直接的价格驱动力。如果市场继续下跌，可能意味着机构对抛售规模或宏观风险的判断过于乐观。

中长期来看，这条新闻的影响可能体现在资金流向上。机构通过喊话引导散户入场，或者通过实际购买行为（而非仅是声明）来验证其判断，这两种路径都会对价格产生支撑。但关键在于，这种支撑力度需要时间验证。

历史类似事件参考有限。2009 年 BTC 启动第一轮牛市前，也没有机构提前发布明确的看多报告。但比特币市场已发生显著变化——机构投资者成为重要力量，其声明的影响力远超以往。

操作思路
💡 基于当前数据，Galaxy 的看多信号更多是情绪指标而非直接的价格催化剂。如果 BTC 跌破 $78,000 这个前期支撑位，意味着市场对机构信号的认可度不足，这种情况下看多逻辑可能被修正。

Ethereum's proof-of-stake system uses the Casper FFG mechanism. Each epoch contains 32 slots and lasts about 6.4 minutes.

The most important thing to remember when managing your positions: for large payments, wait for enough confirmations or finalization before releasing the funds. Don't rely solely on seeing “confirmed on-chain.”

📰 Just as oil plunges and the Fed meeting looms, BTC suddenly holds steady at 80K—but are ETF outflows of 772M the real story?

Oil and U.S. stocks got a little shaky a couple of days ago, and Bitcoin followed with a small dip to around 79K. But now BTC has quietly climbed back and is holding above 80K. The market is waiting for the Fed to speak on Wednesday, but BTC’s recent performance suggests it may not be as worried about the Fed as before. Instead, it seems rattled by other news—especially all that money heading for the exits. According to Binance Square, ETFs saw 772M in outflows last week, a hefty figure and well above the previous week.

Why does this matter?
The underlying reason is that Bitcoin is no longer reacting solely to the Fed. Persistent ETF outflows show that traditional investors still don’t trust crypto. Even if the Fed says all the right things, they may not be willing to invest. Meanwhile, the modest rebound in oil and U.S. stocks has taken some strength out of the dollar, giving BTC a little breathing room. But the biggest issue is that BTC has been stuck around 80K lately. It needs to either break higher or drop lower, which shows just how evenly matched buyers and sellers are. Why the standoff? The money leaving ETFs hasn’t found a better place to go, while expectations of Fed rate hikes are dampening risk appetite. So everyone is waiting for a decisive signal.

Impact on the market
In the short term, BTC holding above 80K offers some breathing room, but whether this support holds depends largely on whether ETF outflows continue. If ETF outflows become routine, it’ll be hard for BTC to rally. In the long term, the market is more concerned with whether ETFs will start seeing substantial inflows. These outflows show that investors are still sitting on the sidelines, waiting for a clear positive catalyst from U.S. stocks or crypto itself. For example, if the Fed doesn’t raise rates this time, or there’s a new sign of regulatory easing, that could encourage money to flow back in. On the other hand, if the Fed does raise rates or regulators continue to crack down, ETF outflows could accelerate.

Trading outlook
For now, BTC around 80K looks a bit like a “bull trap,” but persistent ETF outflows are increasing downside risk. This view would be invalidated if U.S. stocks keep falling or ETF outflows accelerate. Put simply, BTC holders are in an awkward spot: either wait for ETF inflows to return or hope the Fed delivers a surprise.

content:
一张图片谁都能保存下来，为什么有人花钱买它的 NFT？
先讲是什么：ERC-1155 能在同一个合约里一起发行同质化和非同质化代币，常用于游戏道具等场景。
为什么这样：NFT 证明的是这个编号归哪个地址，并不等于就拥有图片的版权，能做什么要看项目的授权条款。

The derivatives market for real-world assets (RWA) is experiencing a boom. Since June, open interest has surged by 192%, nearly reaching the staggering figure of $20 billion.

This phenomenon is about more than simply adding variety to the market. For traders, RWA offers a golden opportunity to gain leveraged exposure to real-world assets (such as stocks or commodities) directly through crypto platforms, without the hassle of physically purchasing the underlying assets.

Going forward, as access to traditional markets through crypto platforms continues to expand, competition between centralized and decentralized ecosystems will become fierce.

In short, RWA has now firmly established itself as a key pillar of the crypto derivatives market. This explosive growth is something every market participant should keep an eye on!

前两天刚说过这件事，现在有了新进展。在 Derive 这个去中心化期权交易所，有个钱包投了 800 枚比特币的看涨期权，赌美国中期选举后比特币能涨到 $90,000 以上。现在 BTC 刚好 $80,402，这个期权面值大概 $64M。这可是 Derive 目前最大的单笔比特币敞口，说明有人觉得中期选举后比特币会继续上涨。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这笔交易是个信号，说明有人不认为中期选举后比特币会跌，反而预期选举后市场情绪会改善。800 枚 BTC 的期权意味着巨大赌注，如果 BTC 真如预期突破 $90,000，这波押注可能带来高额回报。更重要的是，这是在 BTC 持续横盘时出现的行动，比等 BTC 上涨后再加仓更敢下注。

对市场的影响
短期看，这笔交易可能会给 BTC 带来一些买盘，但 $80,402 附近阻力明显，能不能突破 $90,000 关键看美国大选后政策走向。如果美联储鹰派言论持续，或者地缘政治风险加剧，这笔看涨期权的赌注就悬了。从历史看，每次美国选举后 BTC 都有波动，但大趋势还是看宏观流动性。

操作思路
这个事件本身是中性的，但意味着部分市场参与者对中期选举后 BTC 表现有信心。如果 BTC 真突破 $90,000，可能会激活更多类似的多头期权交易。目前 BTC 仍处于 $80,000 关键支撑位，这个期权交易本身不构成直接的买卖信号。

以太坊市场深度分析：两千三百美元防线告急，多重利空压制反弹空间

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十月二十六日，以太坊现货报价两千三百三十点七美元，过去二十四小时微跌百分之零点零四。从最近五根一小时K线来看，价格经历了从两千三百零四美元低点反弹至两千三百三十八美元高位后再度回落的过程，目前在两千三百二十七至两千三百三十八美元区间弱势整理。与比特币相比，以太坊过去三十天跌幅高达百分之十三，远超比特币的百分之五，相对弱势格局明显。

从更大时间框架来看，以太坊正在测试两千三百美元的关键支撑位。三周内市值蒸发约五百四十亿美元，价格从两千五百美元上方持续回落。上周美国现货以太坊ETF录得连续第四周资金外流，总额达两亿两千万美元，与比特币ETF的净流入形成鲜明对比，BTC与ETH的资金面差距正在扩大。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现空头排列格局。七小时均线两千三百二十七美元低于二十五小时均线两千三百三十三美元，两者均远低于九十九小时均线两千三百六十六美元。价格运行在所有主要均线下方，中期下行趋势未改。七小时指数均线两千三百二十九美元刚刚上穿二十五小时指数均线两千三百三十二美元，形成微弱的短期企稳信号，但距离上方压力位仍有较大距离。

布林带上轨收窄至两千三百六十美元，中轨位于两千三百三十一点美元，下轨在两千三百零一美元。价格在中轨附近徘徊，方向选择尚未完成。带宽收窄至近期低位，预示大幅波动即将到来。

MACD指标虽然仍为负值，但出现了边际改善迹象。MACD线从负八上升至负四点三，信号线同步收窄，柱状图连续翻红且数值从零点一六扩大至二点零四，显示空头动能正在减弱。然而MACD仍处于零轴下方，反弹力度有限。RSI六周期读数五十四，处于中性区域，既无超买也无超卖信号。KDJ指标中K值七十九、D值七十、J值九十七，短线偏高但未进入极端区域。

威廉指标从负四十八改善至负二十二，显示短期超卖修复已较为充分。ATR指标从十八降至十六点三，波动率持续下降。抛物线SAR指标位于两千二百九十六美元，低于当前价格，提供短线支撑。

三、市场情绪分析

当前以太坊市场情绪明显偏空。综合信号指标显示十五个因子中仅四个看多、十个看空、一个中性，空头占据绝对优势。复合指标给出做空信号，历史胜率约百分之七十，短线反弹面临较大阻力。

利空因素方面，多重压力叠加。前BitMEX首席执行官Arthur Hayes在美联储决议前抛售了超过四千九百万美元的加密资产，其中包括六千四百枚以太坊。这位此前曾喊出年底以太坊一万美元目标的市场老手选择锁定短期利润，反映出专业投资者对宏观不确定性的担忧。以太坊基金会近期抛售了两千七百八十五枚以太坊，进一步加剧了市场的抛压。更为引人注目的是，一位在二零一五年ICO时期以零点三一美元价格买入十万枚以太坊的远古巨鲸，向交易所存入了第一千五百枚以太坊，按当前价格计算回报率超过七十四万倍。虽然绝对数量不大，但这类长期持有者的陆续离场信号不容忽视。

链上数据方面出现了一些积极信号。鲸鱼从交易所提取了六万五千零六十七枚以太坊至冷钱包，质押比例创下百分之三十六的历史新高，这在一定程度上缓冲了下行流动性。有分析师认为当前的抛售可能正在接近尾声，并将其与二零二六年七月的走势类比，那次调整之后以太坊迎来了百分之三十二的反弹。

协议层面，Glamsterdam测试网因EIP杠八零三七问题暂停，叠加四百八十五万美元的DeFi治理攻击事件，打击了开发者信心。不过代币化股票赛道的蓬勃发展为以太坊生态带来了一线亮色，xStocks发行的代币化股票链上市值突破十亿美元，一年增长百分之八百零二，其中以太坊链占据了重要份额。

综合来看，以太坊短期面临多重利空压制，两千三百美元支撑位的得失将是关键。如果美联储决议释放鸽派信号，可能触发技术性反弹；反之，跌破支撑后可能加速下行至两千两百美元区域。建议投资者保持谨慎，等待明确的企稳信号。

How long does a transaction have to wait before it can truly be considered irreversible?
Finality is the property of a confirmed transaction or block not being reversed or rewritten.
Bitcoin has probabilistic finality: the more blocks added after a transaction, the lower the probability it will be reversed, though in theory that probability never reaches zero.
The most important thing to remember when managing your positions: deposits and withdrawals across different chains require different confirmation times, so a delay in funds arriving doesn’t necessarily mean something has gone wrong.

📰 Why should shareholders lose sleep over Strive hoarding 43K Bitcoin?

Strive, a DeFi platform, recently bought another 6,182 Bitcoin, bringing its reserves to a staggering 43,000 BTC. This move may look like an expansion of its portfolio, but it may not be good news for ordinary shareholders: if Bitcoin prices keep falling, losses on these crypto holdings could hit shareholders directly.

Why does this news matter?
Strive’s move once again highlights the double-edged sword of Web3 players hoarding Bitcoin. On the one hand, buying the dip in a bear market is standard practice for institutions and can be seen as a bet on Bitcoin’s long-term value. On the other hand, Strive’s business model—including market making and staking—depends on stable BTC prices. If BTC falls below its cost basis, these reserves could become a major financial drag. This means the company wants to benefit when Bitcoin rises, but is also wary of a steep decline.

Market impact
The news may provide a slight positive sentiment boost for BTC, since another big player has added to its holdings. But on a deeper level, it reflects DeFi institutions’ preference for treating Bitcoin as a “risk-free asset” in the current low-interest-rate environment. This means:
- BTC’s safe-haven appeal is being reinforced once again, especially before the macro interest-rate environment shifts;
- But if expectations of more aggressive rate cuts emerge in the future, outflows could put an end to this kind of accumulation;
- The impact on other cryptocurrencies such as ETH is limited, as ETH’s ecosystem is more independent.

Trading perspective
For now, Strive’s “Bitcoin hoarding” strategy seems more like icing on the cake than a lifeline. For BTC, this means sentiment may get a slight short-term boost, but the underlying trend will still depend on Bitcoin’s own supply and demand. If Bitcoin can stay above $80K, this kind of accumulation could continue to lift market sentiment.

Strive这家DeFi平台最近又狂买6,182枚比特币，现在手上的比特币储备达到了惊人的43,000枚。这波操作看着是加大了投资组合，但对普通股东来说，可能不是好消息——如果比特币价格继续下跌，这些加密货币的账面亏损会直接砸股东的头。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Strive此举再次凸显了Web3玩家囤比特币的“双刃剑”效应。一方面，在熊市抄底是机构的常规操作，可以理解为在赌比特币的长期价值；另一方面，Strive的商业模式（如做市、质押）依赖BTC价格稳定，如果BTC跌破其成本价，这些储备币就会变成巨大的财务拖累。这意味着它既想跟着比特币涨，又怕比特币跌得太惨。

对市场的影响
对BTC本身是微弱的正面情绪刺激，毕竟又是大玩家加仓。但更深层次看，它反映了DeFi机构在当前低利率环境下，把比特币当作“无风险资产”的偏好。这意味着：
- BTC的避险属性被再次强化，尤其是在宏观利率环境没有转向前；
- 但如果未来出现更猛烈的降息预期，这类囤币行为可能被资金流出打破；

ETH fund files for in-kind creations and redemptions | Fewer passive spot-conversion steps | I only enter after price confirmation

My stance is cautiously bullish, but I wouldn’t present a filing update as new buying today. An amendment to the registration statement for the Franklin Ethereum ETF (EZET) on the U.S. SEC website states explicitly in the explanatory note that it is intended to reflect that the fund may create and redeem shares in-kind, while also updating exhibits and other information; it does not add newly registered shares. The filing separately describes cash and in-kind creation and redemption procedures. Under the in-kind redemption process, eligible participants can redeem creation units and receive ETH. Ordinary secondary-market holders still cannot exchange individual shares directly for ETH. This concerns the fund’s operational plumbing, not an upgrade to the Ethereum protocol, and it does not mean the fund has already bought a large amount of ETH. The filing also includes a delayed-effectiveness amendment, so the actual implementation status should be checked against the fund’s subsequent disclosures; a filing does not mean every step is already in place.

Why does this detail matter for trading? Cash creations and redemptions typically require the institutions involved to buy or sell ETH in the market to settle in cash. In-kind creations and redemptions allow ETH to be transferred between eligible participants, custodians, and the fund, potentially reducing repeated conversions and slippage at certain times. This may improve arbitrage efficiency and help the fund’s price track its net asset value more closely, but it does not change ETH’s total issuance or automatically bring in net new capital. What truly affects spot supply and demand is the ongoing net amount of creations and redemptions, as well as participants’ hedging activity. Farside’s ETH fund table can be used for a retrospective check, but the most recent row has missing fund data, so I wouldn’t treat the page’s automatically calculated subtotal as a complete net-flow figure. The filing also lists risks including delays in on-chain transfers, network congestion, and interruptions to custody services—a reminder that in-kind processes are not frictionless.

At the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,327, with a rolling 24-hour high of about $2,362 and low of about $2,291; the UTC daily open was around $2,327. Price remains near the middle of the range, and there’s no evidence that today’s volatility was driven solely by this filing from several days ago. In the short term, I see resistance at $2,360–$2,380 and support at $2,290–$2,300. A break below $2,290 followed by a rebound that fails to reclaim it would invalidate my cautiously steady short-term view. If price breaks above $2,380 while ETF net-flow data strengthens, I’d assign more weight to a continuation of the trend. The Federal Reserve’s October 27–28 meeting this week could shift interest-rate expectations for risk assets, and macro factors may outweigh an operational change at a single fund.

If I were trading this myself, I’d wait for now rather than chase the price near $2,327. I’d only take a spot long position, with a maximum planned allocation of 7% of total capital and no leverage. The entry trigger would be ETH closing above $2,380 on the four-hour chart, then holding above $2,360 on a retest, while verifiable ETF data shows no clear pattern of consecutive redemptions. Once triggered, I’d start with a 3% position and add up to 4% more only after confirmation. My first target would be $2,440, where I’d sell half; my second target would be $2,510, where I’d sell half of the remaining position, then move the stop on the final portion up to trail price. I’d set the initial stop at $2,340. If ETH falls back below $2,290 on the four-hour chart or fund flows deteriorate consecutively, I’d close the entire position. If these conditions aren’t met, I won’t participate. These are only planned actions, not trades that have already been executed.

Sources: SEC EZET amended registration statement, Farside ETH fund flow table, Franklin fund materials, Federal Reserve meeting schedule, Kraken quotes. #ETH

我的态度是审慎偏多，但不把文件更新写成今天的新增买盘。美国SEC网站上的Franklin Ethereum ETF（EZET）注册文件补充修订，解释栏明确写明：此次是为反映基金可以进行实物方式的份额创建与赎回，同时更新附件和其他资料，并没有因此新增注册份额。文件正文分别列出现金与实物申赎流程；实物赎回路径下，合格参与人按创建单位赎回，可接收ETH，普通二级市场持有人仍不能把零散份额直接拿去换币。这里谈的是基金运营管道，不是以太坊协议升级，也不是“基金已经大量买入ETH”。文件还有延迟生效的修订声明，所以实际执行状态要继续看基金后续披露，不能把申报等同所有环节已经落地。

为什么这个细节影响交易？现金申赎通常要求相关机构在市场上卖出或买入ETH来完成现金交割；实物申赎允许在合格参与人、托管方与基金之间转移ETH，有机会降低某些时段的重复转换和滑点。它可能改善套利效率与基金价格对净值的贴合，但不会改变ETH总发行量，也不自动带来净资金流入。真正对现货供需有影响的是持续申购赎回净额和参与人的对冲操作。Farside的ETH基金表可用来后验观察，但最近一行有基金栏位缺数据，我不会把页面自动小计说成完整资金净流。SEC文件列出的链上转账延迟、网络拥堵与托管服务中断风险，也提醒实物流程并非无摩擦。

写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2327美元，滚动24小时高约2362、低约2291美元，UTC日开约2327美元。价格仍落在区间中部，没有证据表明今天的波动由这份几天前的申报单独驱动。短线我看2360至2380美元压力、2290至2300美元支撑；若跌破2290美元且反弹收不回，就推翻短线偏稳判断。若突破2380美元同时ETF净流数据转强，才提高趋势延续的权重。本周美联储10月27至28日会议会改变风险资产的利率预期，宏观因素可能盖过单只基金的运营变化。

如果是我自己交易，当前选择等，不在2327美元附近追价；方向只做现货多单，总资金计划上限7%，不用杠杆。入场触发是ETH四小时收在2380美元上方，回踩2360美元仍守住，同时可核实的ETF数据未显示连续明显赎回；触发后先用3%试仓，确认后最多再加4%。目标一是2440美元，先减一半；目标二是2510美元，再减剩余仓位的一半，最后余仓上移止损跟随。初始止损设在2340美元；若四小时跌回2290美元下方或基金流向连续恶化，全部平仓。条件没到就是不参与，这些都只是预设动作，不是已经成交。

来源：SEC EZET修订注册文件、Farside ETH基金资金表、Franklin基金资料、美联储会议日程、Kraken报价。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

Why do you end up with different amounts of tokens on different platforms when making the same swap?
First, what’s going on: the quotes shown by aggregators are only estimates. The actual trade is also affected by slippage settings and changes in on-chain conditions.
The logic behind it: splitting orders has a cost too. Each additional pool uses more Gas, and for small amounts, the price improvement you save may not make up for the extra Gas.
When swapping through an aggregator on Ethereum, $ETH  Gas was paid. $1INCH is 1inch’s governance token. The current price is 2330.02.
It’s okay to take things slowly. Staying in the game matters far more than making a big profit just once.

translatedData.content:
South Korea’s crypto income tax, originally set to take effect on January 1, 2027, looks set to be delayed by another two years.

A few details that are easy to miss 👇

🔹 The tax rate remains about 22% in total (other income tax + local tax). Each year, income from transferring or lending virtual assets is taxed only after deducting the basic exemption of 2.5 million won—the rules are laid out in the current Income Tax Act and haven’t changed.
🔹 Under the original plan, the tax would take effect on New Year’s Day next year. Another delay would be the fourth since the legislation was passed in 2020, with 2029 widely cited as the new target year.
🔹 Presidential office officials told Korean media that discussions are “moving in the direction of a delay,” but the public position remains that “no final decision has been made.” Don’t mistake media reports for an amendment to the law.
🔹 One key concern: the US won’t join the OECD’s Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF) until 2029. If South Korea taxes crypto first and information from major overseas exchanges doesn’t match up, the tax burden could fall more heavily on users of domestic exchanges—drawing criticism of “reverse discrimination.”
🔹 Rules are also still incomplete for complex transactions, including deposits from overseas, cost-basis calculations for self-custody wallets, airdrops, and staking. The ruling party has already proposed an amendment to push the tax’s start date to 2029, and the opposition broadly supports another delay. The November tax review will be a key moment to watch.

Put simply: for South Korean retail investors, this looks more like another two-year reprieve from having to rush into tax planning around a 22% rate. But the reprieve isn’t permanent—the tax will only be truly delayed if the National Assembly changes that 2027 date in the law.

Do you think a fourth delay would be pragmatic, or another case of regulation being kicked down the road?

原定 2027 年 1 月 1 日开征的韩国加密所得税，眼看又要再拖两年。

几个容易被忽略的细节👇

🔹 税率仍是「其他所得税 + 地方税」合计约 22%，每年虚拟资产转让/出借所得，先扣基本免税额 250 万韩元，超出部分再计税——这一套写在现行《所得税法》里，没变

Why do people say Bitcoin needs “6 confirmations,” while Ethereum talks about “finality”?
Ethereum requires two-thirds of staked validators to participate in voting for finality. If too many validators go offline, finality pauses, but blocks continue to be produced as usual.
Finality is the property that confirmed transactions or blocks cannot be reversed or rewritten.
The old me: Jump in first, figure it out later. The current me: Read the manual.

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#ETH #Gas #BTC

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Are the Fuel Costs of a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay Gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring funds, trading, running a
contract) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (Gas unit price).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A booming market → a surge in on-chain transactions → soaring Gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they choose to do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

美国现货加密ETF，纽约交易时段10月19日至23日那一周，资金流终于扭头。

$BTC现货ETF当周净流入约3.012亿美元，结束连续两周净流出。日度很拧巴：周一到周三分别约+5.267亿、+2320万、+5.248亿，周四却大吐约6.356亿——那是6月以来单日最大流出——周五再流出约1.379亿。前半周猛吸、后半周吐回大半，周线仍勉强转正。贝莱德IBIT当周仍净流入约5.657亿，扛住了尾盘回吐；自2024年1月累计约572.5亿美元。

同一周，$ETH现货ETF净流出约2.207亿美元，ETHA一家就流出约2.332亿。机构资金这一周更偏$BTC。

10月26日东八晚间，$BTC仍在约8万美元附近承压，联储本周决议氛围下波动不小。资金流周线转正，不等于盘面立刻松口气。

U.S. spot crypto ETFs finally reversed course during the New York trading week of October 19–23.

$BTC spot ETFs saw net inflows of about $301.2 million for the week, ending two consecutive weeks of net outflows. Daily flows were choppy: about +$526.7 million Monday, +$23.2 million Tuesday, and +$524.8 million Wednesday, followed by a sharp outflow of about $635.6 million Thursday—the biggest single-day outflow since June—and another outflow of about $137.9 million Friday. Strong inflows early in the week were mostly given back later, but the weekly total still managed to turn positive. BlackRock’s IBIT still saw net inflows of about $565.7 million for the week, weathering the late-week reversal; cumulative inflows since January 2024 reached about $57.25 billion.

translatedData.content:
An address with a cost basis of $0.31 deposited 1,500 ETH into an exchange. At $2,332.93, that’s about $3.5 million.

First, put that figure in perspective: ETH’s 24-hour trading volume is 6,014.4M USDT, or $6.01 billion, making this transfer 0.058% of the total. Open interest in perpetuals is $5.438 billion, so the transfer amounts to 0.064% of that. It’s not large enough to rank among the flows that move prices in either market. So what’s really worth examining isn’t the size, but the timing and the route it took.

First, consider the unrealized gain on these coins. From $0.31 to $2,332.93 is roughly a 7,500x return. There’s an often-overlooked side effect to that kind of multiple: price anchoring no longer applies to addresses like this. Whether ETH is at $2,332 or $2,300 is just a rounding detail on the ledger. They don’t need to wait for a “good price”—they just need a market that can absorb the coins. That explains why ETH moved only +0.15% over 24 hours after the news broke: the seller had no reason to haggle with the order book, and buyers weren’t forced to bid prices up. The two sides completed the trade around the current price.

Second, the funding rate put a very cheap price on this supply. The 8-hour funding rate is +0.0067%, or about 7.3% annualized, meaning longs are still paying to hold their positions. In a market where longs are paying, sellers actually have a lower-friction route: they don’t need to hit the spot order book and create depth; someone on the perpetuals side is already paying the cost of holding. From this perspective, the cashing out of ancient coins and pricing on the leveraged side are disconnected—the premium implied by the funding rate reflects only longs’ willingness to hold positions, and doesn’t account for these coins from a decade ago entering the supply curve at all. Leveraged markets have never priced in “coins that already exist”; they price in whether “someone will sell in the future.” This time, they already have.

Third, there’s a structural imbalance. Long accounts make up 77.2% of accounts, so account positioning is almost uniformly bullish. Yet the funding rate implies only a modest 7.3% annualized premium, with no signs of crowded pricing. Put together, these figures suggest that the capital behind the largest positions isn’t chasing a direction; marginal buyers are retail accounts, not large holders. The result is reduced elasticity: funding is less likely to spike during a rally, while the fuel for a cascade of stop-losses on a decline is concentrated among that 77.2%. With $5.438 billion in open interest against $6.01 billion in daily volume, intraday turnover is about 1.1x. The market is active, but it’s retail doing the trading.

Fourth, consider what we can’t see. Wallets from the ICO era rarely consist of just one address, and their holders rarely sell everything at once. If 1,500 coins are only the first batch, subsequent sales could be quietly completed in a market with ample turnover, where the impact of each individual trade is diluted. Precisely because they make no splash, price discovery may lag behind the actual distribution. That English-language post about an ICO whale deposit on the plaza got only 11 likes and 1 comment. The discussion was far quieter than the event’s scale would suggest, indicating that the market has become desensitized to “ancient coins being sold off.” That’s not necessarily bad, but it means the market may be half a beat slow when a large-scale, staged sell-off actually happens.

My view is that what to watch next isn’t whether $2,332 can hold, but two things: whether net exchange inflows stay positive, and whether the 8-hour funding rate falls below zero. If the rate turns negative, longs will have stopped paying. The next wave of those $0.31 coins would then have to create real depth on the spot order book, instead of being absorbed by the premium on perpetuals. If you’re holding a position, watching the direction of the funding rate is more informative than watching for a new price low. The risk this time isn’t this $3.5 million transfer; it’s that you can’t know whether it was the last one.

#ETH #巨鲸 #Crypto

content:
一个成本 0.31 美元的地址，把 1500 枚 ETH 打进了交易所。按 2332.93 算，约 350 万美元。

先把这个数字放到它该待的位置上：ETH 24 小时成交额 6014.4M USDT，也就是 60.1 亿美元，这笔货占 0.058%；合约持仓量 54.38 亿 USDT，它占 0.064%。两个市场里它都排不进影响价格的那一档。所以真正值得读的不是规模，是它出现的时点和它选择的路径。

第一件事，这笔货的浮盈倍数。0.31 到 2332.93，大约 7500 倍。这个倍数有一个被忽略的副作用：价格锚定对这类地址彻底失效。2332 还是 2300，对它只是账面数字的第四位小数，它不需要等一个“好价格”，只需要一个能吃得下货的市场。这解释了为什么消息落地后 ETH 24h 只动了 +0.15%——卖方没有跟盘口讨价还价的动机，买方也没有被逼到必须抬价的境地，双方在现价附近就完成了交换。

第二件事，费率给这笔供应定了个很便宜的价。8 小时资金费率 +0.0067%，折年约 7.3%，多头还在为持仓付费。在一个多头付费的市场里，卖方其实有一条摩擦更小的路：不必在现货盘口上砸出深度，永续端已经有人替持有成本买了单。从这个角度看，远古筹码兑现和杠杆端的定价是脱节的——费率给出的溢价只反映多头的持仓意愿，完全没把这批十年前的筹码计入供应曲线。杠杆市场从来不为“已经存在的币”定价，它只为“未来会不会有人卖”定价，而这次是已经卖了。

第三件事，结构上的不对称。多头账户占比 77.2%，账户层面几乎一边倒地看多，但费率只给出折年 7.3% 的温和溢价，没有出现拥挤定价。两组数字放在一起说明：真正压着大额仓位的资金没在追方向，边际买方是散户账户而不是大额持仓。这种结构的后果是弹性变差——上涨时费率不容易冲高，下跌时止损踩踏的燃料却集中在那 77.2% 里。54.38 亿持仓对 60.1 亿日成交，日内换手约 1.1 倍，市场是活的，但活的是散户的手。

第四件事，看不见的部分。ICO 时代的地址很少只有一个钱包，也很少一次清完。1500 枚如果只是第一批，后面的分批会在一个换手充分、单笔冲击被稀释的市场里静默完成——正因为激不起水花，价格发现会滞后于实际派发。今天广场上那条英文的 ICO 巨鲸存款帖只拿到 11 赞 1 评，讨论热度远低于事件本身的量级，说明市场对“远古筹码出货”已经脱敏。脱敏不是坏事，但它意味着真到大额分批的时候，反应会慢半拍。

我的看法是，接下来该盯的不是 2332 这个位置能不能守住，而是两个东西：交易所净流入是否连续为正，以及 8 小时费率会不会回到零轴下方。费率一旦翻负，等于多头停止付费，那批 0.31 的筹码下一轮就得在现货盘口上真正砸出深度，而不是靠永续端的溢价消化。手上有仓位的，把观察点放在费率的方向变化上，比盯价格新低更有信息量。这轮的风险不在这一笔 350 万美元，在于你无法确认它是不是最后一笔。

More important things to watch are holdings transparency, rebalancing rules, and whether, after listing, it will compete with existing spot ETFs for the same pool of allocation capital. BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF saw net inflows of $305M last week, reversing the $229M in outflows the week before and drawing institutional investors’ attention back to Bitcoin. Meanwhile, Ethereum ETFs continued to see outflows of $220M, reflecting bearish market sentiment toward altcoins. Net ETF inflows reflect recognition of Bitcoin’s safe-haven properties as “digital gold” amid rising macroeconomic risks. This coincides with recent inflation data and geopolitical risks. More importantly, BlackRock’s actions could influence the strategies of other asset managers, setting an example for the industry.

Continued outflows from Ethereum ETFs point to a structural divide in the market: Bitcoin is benefiting from sustained institutional inflows, while Ethereum faces the twin pressures of slowing growth in its developer ecosystem and insufficient institutional demand. This divergence means Ethereum will need a clear technical signal or a new catalyst to attract capital again.

Market impact
In the short term, BlackRock’s ETF inflows could support Bitcoin as it trades around $80,000. The impact on the market landscape could be profound: ongoing inflows into Bitcoin ETFs are redefining the boundaries of “institutional crypto.” This suggests institutional capital may increasingly favor Bitcoin ETFs over direct investments in native cryptocurrencies, posing a challenge to the long-term prospects of tokens such as Ethereum.

A historical parallel is the market reaction when Bitcoin ETFs first won approval in 2018. Institutional inflows at the time also failed to halt Bitcoin’s decline, showing that ETF inflows are only one of many factors affecting prices.

Trading outlook
BlackRock’s ETF inflows suggest Bitcoin has found support around $80,000, but whether this can turn into a sustained rally depends on whether inflows continue. content:
📰 Blackrock力挽狂澜，$305M比特币ETF流入为何改变不了以太颓势？

Blackrock的比特币ETF上周净流入$305M，逆转了此前一周$229M的流出，让机构投资者重新关注比特币。但以太坊ETF持续$220M流出，显示出市场对山寨币的悲观情绪。黑石的行动是机构资金回流的表现，但比特币能否借此摆脱近期颓势，还取决于市场情绪和宏观环境。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Blackrock的行动意味着机构投资者重新评估了比特币的配置价值。ETF净流入反映了对宏观经济风险增加下，比特币作为"数字黄金"避险属性的认可。这与近期的通胀数据、地缘政治风险形成共振。更重要的是，Blackrock的操作可能改变了其他资产管理机构的策略参考，形成示范效应。

以太坊ETF持续流出则说明市场正在经历结构性分化：比特币受益于机构资金的持续流入，而以太坊正面临开发者生态增长放缓和机构需求不足的双重压力。这种分化意味着以太坊需要出现明确的技术信号或新催化剂，才能重新吸引资金。

对市场的影响
短期内，Blackrock的ETF流入将支撑比特币价格在$80,000附近震荡。但考虑到比特币ETF自2024年推出以来的整体流出趋势，$305M的流入只是短暂的脉冲，未必能改变中期下降趋势。更值得关注的是，如果黑石持续增持，可能引发监管机构的关注，形成"政策风险"的新变量。

对市场格局的影响是深远的：比特币ETF的持续流入正在重新定义"机构加密货币"的边界。这意味着未来机构资金可能更倾向于配置比特币ETF，而非直接投资原生加密货币。这对以太坊等代币的长期发展构成了挑战。

历史上类似事件可以参考2018年比特币ETF首次获批时的市场反应。当时机构资金流入也未能阻止比特币的下跌，显示出ETF流入只是影响价格的一部分因素。

操作思路
Blackrock的ETF流入意味着比特币在$80,000附近获得了支撑，但这是否能转化为持续上涨，取决于后续资金流入能否持续。如果未来一周ETF流入低于$250M，这个判断作废。比特币需要在没有新的机构资金催化剂的情况下，依靠技术面反弹至$83,000才能确认趋势反转。

Today's lesson: transaction finality
On Ethereum, a checkpoint is finalized only when validators representing two-thirds of the staked ETH vote to approve it.
When receiving a large payment, wait for enough confirmations or for finality before shipping—don't rely on it merely being “on-chain.”
On Ethereum, the staked $ETH  is the guarantee of finality: rewriting finalized blocks would result in a large amount of stake being lost.

title: A GOOD DECISION CAN STILL LOSE. A BAD DECISION CAN STILL WIN.
subTitle:
Here's something every crypto beginner needs to understand. You research a project, assess the risks, and follow your plan. But the market moves against you. You lose money. Does that automatically mean your decision was foolish? Not necessarily.
Now imagine buying a coin because someone promised it would rise 100%. The price goes up, and you make a profit. Does that automatically mean your decision was wise? Not necessarily either. HERE'S WHY.
1️⃣ RESULTS DON'T TELL THE WHOLE STORY.
One profitable trade doesn't prove that your approach is reliable.
2️⃣ LUCK CAN LOOK LIKE SKILL.
A risky decision may work once without being a good decision to repeat.
3️⃣ LOSSES CAN TEACH YOU SOMETHING.
A well-researched decision can still produce an unexpected outcome. Review what happened and learn from it.
4️⃣ YOUR PROCESS MATTERS.
Did you understand the asset? Consider the downside? Follow your risk limits?
5️⃣ REVIEW YOUR DECISIONS HONESTLY.
Don't judge every decision only by whether you made or lost money. Look at the information you had and how you used it.
🔑 REMEMBER: You cannot control every outcome, but you can improve your decision-making process. The goal isn't to be right every time. The goal is to learn, manage risk, and avoid repeating mistakes without understanding them.

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

🔥 Technical deep dive: Transaction finality
Probabilistic finality is like a stack of paper that keeps getting taller: the more sheets piled on top, the harder it is to pull out the one at the bottom. Deterministic finality is like a signed contract: once it’s signed, you can’t take it back.
When depositing or withdrawing between different chains, confirmation times vary from chain to chain, so a slow arrival doesn’t necessarily mean something has gone wrong.
On Ethereum, the staked $ETH  is the guarantee of finality: rewriting a finalized block would result in the loss of a large amount of stake.

Overall, Ethereum’s technical picture points to a weak rebound, with strong resistance in the $2,360–$2,370 range. The price may continue to trade within a range in the near term.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

The greatest pressure on Ethereum comes from ongoing institutional outflows. Data shows that U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs recorded net outflows of approximately $220 million last week, marking a fourth consecutive week of net outflows and contrasting sharply with net inflows into Bitcoin ETFs. The continued withdrawal of institutional capital is weighing significantly on Ethereum’s price.

On-chain data shows that addresses linked to the Ethereum Foundation recently sold 2,785 ETH. Meanwhile, an early holder from the ICO era transferred 1,500 ETH to an exchange after nearly nine years of dormancy. At current prices, the transfer is worth approximately $3.46 million. These large sell signals have heightened bearish market sentiment. Well-known trader Arthur Hayes also sold more than $49 million in crypto assets ahead of the Federal Reserve decision, including 6,400 ETH.

There are also some positive signs. More than 36% of Ethereum’s circulating supply is currently locked in staking contracts, which to some extent limits the release of concentrated selling pressure. Based on trading signal statistics, seven of 15 factors are bullish, seven are bearish, and one is neutral, leaving the market evenly balanced between bulls and bears as it reaches a key decision point.

At the macro level, Ethereum also faces pressure from competitors such as Solana. The market capitalization of tokenized stocks on-chain has exceeded $1 billion, with Solana leading at $523 million, while Ethereum’s share is being eroded. This week’s Federal Reserve decision and key economic data will determine whether Ethereum can hold the critical $2,300 support level.

Among popular tokens, ERA is trading at $0.0889, up 19.33% over 24 hours; KAT is at $0.00481, up 19.06%; and OSMO is at $0.0531, up 18.26%. Overall risk appetite has improved, but whether Ethereum can join the rally remains to be seen as market flows evolve.

content:
以太坊ETH市场深度分析：ETF持续失血，两千三百美元能否守住

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间2026年10月26日下午六点，以太坊现货报价2333美元，过去24小时上涨约0.42%。从小时K线来看，ETH在本周初同样经历了一波回调，价格最低触及2304美元，随后在买盘承接下反弹至2336美元附近，目前在2330美元一线窄幅整理。

布林带数据显示，上轨位于2363美元，中轨位于2332美元，下轨位于2300美元，当前价格运行在中轨与上轨之间，短线偏向强势。7小时均线报2326美元，25小时均线报2333美元，两者高度粘合，99小时均线位于2367美元，构成上方关键阻力。价格若要确认反弹趋势，需要有效突破2367美元的长期均线压制。

成交量方面，在价格反弹至2336美元时，单小时成交额达到1520万美元，随后回落阶段成交量迅速萎缩至85万美元，显示多头在高位缺乏持续进攻动力。整体来看，以太坊的价格结构仍然弱于比特币，反弹力度相对有限。

二、技术指标解读

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI报51.6，十二周期报47.9，二十四周期报45.7，短周期RSI刚刚回到中性区域，显示超卖修复仍在进行中。MACD指标显示DIFF线报负5.44，DEA线报负6.94，柱状图连续三个周期为正值并扩大至1.50，空头动能正在衰减，但尚未形成金叉，反弹信号仍需确认。

KDJ指标显示K值为73.1，D值为63.5，J值为92.2，J值已经进入高位区域，短线存在超买风险。威廉指标WR报负41.5，处于中性偏强区域。随机RSI指标报87.1，其均线为82.6，两者均处于高位，与BTC类似，短线存在技术性回调压力。

ATR十四周期数值为16.2美元，较前期18美元有所下降，波动率收敛。抛物线SAR指标报2295美元，位于当前价格下方，提供短线支撑。综合来看，以太坊技术面呈现弱势反弹格局，上方2360至2370美元区域存在较强阻力，短期内可能维持区间震荡。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场面临的最大压力来自机构资金的持续流出。数据显示，美国现货以太坊ETF上周录得约2.2亿美元净流出，这已经是连续第四周资金净流出，与比特币ETF的净流入形成鲜明对比。机构资金的持续撤离对以太坊的价格形成显著压制。

链上数据方面，以太坊基金会关联地址近期出售了2785枚ETH，同时一位ICO时期的早期持有者在沉寂近九年后，将1500枚ETH转入交易所，按当前价格计算价值约346万美元。这些大额抛售信号加剧了市场的悲观情绪。知名交易员Arthur Hayes也在美联储决议前抛售了超过4900万美元的加密资产，其中包括6400枚ETH。

不过也有积极信号。目前超过36%的以太坊流通供应量被锁定在质押合约中，这在一定程度上限制了卖盘的集中释放。从交易信号统计来看，十五个因子中有七个做多、七个做空、一个中性，多空力量完全均衡，市场处于方向选择的关键时刻。

宏观层面，以太坊还面临来自Solana等竞争对手的压力。链上代币化股票市值突破10亿美元，其中Solana以5.23亿美元领先，以太坊的份额正在被蚕食。本周的美联储决议和重要经济数据将决定以太坊能否守住2300美元的关键支撑位。

热门代币方面，ERA报价0.0889美元，24小时涨幅19.33%；KAT报价0.00481美元，涨幅19.06%；OSMO报价0.0531美元，涨幅18.26%。市场整体风险偏好有所回暖，但以太坊能否跟上涨幅仍需观察资金面变化。

translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest beginner misconception: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, jumping in and out every day,
until fees and volatility wear away their capital.

In reality, staying flat is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t read the market, stay flat,
Stay flat when bulls and bears are battling; stay flat after a few consecutive losing trades—the money you save in these three situations
is more than most people make from trading.

You may be tired of the hunting analogy, but the principle is real: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. Keep capital on hand, and when an opportunity comes, you’ll have bullets to fire. Hold on to your bullets.

📰 Why Could the FOMC and Earnings Reports Crush Bitcoin? What Is the Biggest Risk Facing BTC This Week?

Bitcoin successfully held the $80,000 support level last weekend, but it is now facing pressure from both the Federal Reserve’s interest rate meeting and earnings reports from tech giants. Either event could suddenly shift market sentiment and trigger a sharp pullback in Bitcoin’s price. As one of the world’s leading cryptocurrencies, BTC often sees its volatility magnified by macroeconomic events like these, so investors need to keep a close eye on their impact.

The reason the Fed’s FOMC meeting and tech stock earnings are so important to BTC is that they directly affect global risk appetite. On the one hand, the outcome of the FOMC meeting will determine the Fed’s interest rate policy over the coming months, which has implications for the strength of the U.S. dollar and global liquidity. On the other hand, tech stock earnings reflect trends in the U.S. technology sector, a key bellwether for the Nasdaq and global stock markets. Both events are happening in quick succession this week, and their combined effects could lead to sharp market swings.

In terms of regulatory trends, U.S. regulators have recently maintained a cautious stance. FOMC meetings often fuel speculation about the direction of future policy, while tech earnings can expose risks facing the industry. Together, these events could become a turning point for bulls and bears. If the data falls short of expectations, or the Fed signals further rate hikes, downside pressure on risk assets, including BTC, could intensify.

From a capital-flow perspective, inflows into global ETFs have recently slowed, suggesting that long-term investors’ attitudes toward risk assets are shifting. Against this backdrop, any negative news could trigger a wave of selling. Historical data shows that similar events in 2023 caused Bitcoin’s price to fall by more than 10% in 24 hours. This means BTC’s price action could be more complicated than usual this week.

Impact on the Market
The impact of these two events on BTC will mainly be reflected in short-term sentiment and medium-term trends. The market could see sharp volatility in the short term, but the long-term trend will still depend on Bitcoin’s own fundamentals.

First, the outcome of the FOMC meeting could directly trigger a reversal in the U.S. dollar’s trajectory. If the Fed signals rate cuts, the dollar could weaken and BTC’s price in dollar terms could rise. Conversely, if the Fed continues raising rates, the dollar could keep appreciating and BTC’s dollar price could fall. Historical data shows that after the Fed raised rates in May 2023, Bitcoin’s price fell by more than 30% over the following month.

Second, tech stock earnings could affect investor sentiment. If earnings beat expectations, the Nasdaq could rise, and BTC’s market cap could grow along with it. Conversely, if earnings fall short of expectations, the Nasdaq could decline, potentially dragging BTC’s market cap down as well. Historical data shows that after Meta reported weaker-than-expected earnings in 2022, Bitcoin’s price fell by more than 8% the following day.

As for the regulatory environment, U.S. regulators’ stance toward cryptocurrencies remains uncertain. The FOMC meeting could prompt speculation about whether the U.S. position on cryptocurrencies is changing. If the Fed signals that it will further regulate cryptocurrencies, downside pressure on BTC could intensify. Conversely, if the Fed continues to take an open-minded approach to cryptocurrencies, BTC could have more room to rise.

In terms of capital flows, these two events could affect the behavior of institutional investors. If both the FOMC meeting and tech earnings come in better than expected, institutional investors may continue increasing their BTC allocations. Conversely, if both disappoint, institutions may reduce their BTC allocations. Historical data shows that after Bitcoin ETF inflows accelerated in June 2023, Bitcoin’s price rose by more than 20% over the following month.

美联储FOMC会议和科技股财报之所以对BTC如此重要，根本原因在于它们直接影响全球风险偏好。一方面，FOMC会议的结果会决定美联储未来几个月的利率政策，这关系到美元强弱和全球流动性；另一方面，科技股的财报反映了美国科技行业的发展趋势，而这一行业是纳斯达克和全球股市的重要风向标。这两个事件都在本周密集发生，叠加效应可能导致市场出现剧烈波动。

简单说：本周BTC面临的最大风险来自于宏观基本面数据的叠加影响，如果FOMC会议和科技股财报都出现不及预期的数据，那么比特币价格可能会出现大幅回调。

ETH Watch | Geth proposes an RPC fix today | Separate interface issues from on-chain risks

My view is neutral to cautiously optimistic, and I’m not treating a developer proposal as bullish for ETH prices for now. Today I checked the official Ethereum Geth repository. A PR opened on October 26, #36019, proposes fixing an RPC interface behavior: when a single “notification” request exceeds its time limit, the node may currently return a timeout error. Under the JSON-RPC 2.0 specification, a notification should not receive a response even if it fails. The proposal aims to retain internal timeout logging and cancellation handling while suppressing these unnecessary responses; ordinary calls with request IDs would continue returning timeouts as before. The project page shows that it is still Open, requires review by code owners, and has not yet been deployed. This should not be described as an Ethereum mainnet outage, stolen funds, or a drop in gas fees.

The market significance here is infrastructure quality, not immediate supply and demand for the coin. Wallets, trading bots, and data services use RPC to read data and send requests. If an application mistakes an unsolicited notification response for the result of a genuine user call, it could create noisy alerts or confuse retry logic. The fix could make interface behavior more predictable. But user fund security also depends on signing, node configuration, and the application’s own validation. An RPC patch that has not been merged will not directly change block capacity, fee burning, or staking yields. I’ll watch for code review, merging, an official release, and upgrades by operators before assessing whether it actually improves service stability.

We also need to be honest about price. At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,327.40, compared with the UTC daily open at $2,326.62, and a rolling 24-hour high of $2,361.91 and low of $2,290.71. A price close to the open does not support the narrative that “the proposal is driving ETH higher.” Farside’s October 23 ETH ETF table still has a blank ETHV entry, so the apparent total should not be treated as complete net inflows. In the short term, I’m watching whether ETH can reclaim $2,335–$2,340; above that, $2,360 is the next level to watch. Below, first comes $2,310, then $2,290. If it cannot hold above $2,340, or breaks below $2,290 and then fails to rebound convincingly, the bullish setup is invalidated.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. The only direction I’d consider is a conditional spot long, with each position capped at 1.5% of total capital. Entry requires all of the following: ETH holds above $2,340 for at least an hour, BTC is not plunging, and trading volume is not just a single-candle spike. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,360, and close the remaining position at the second target of $2,390. The initial stop-loss would be below $2,308; if triggered, I’d exit. I’d also exit early if ETH still cannot hold $2,335 a day after entry, or if the Geth proposal is withdrawn or more serious contrary evidence emerges. This is only a plan whose conditions have not been triggered—not a claim that I have bought or made a profit.

ETH观察｜Geth今日新增RPC修复提案｜先分清接口与链上风险

我的态度是中性偏谨慎，暂不把开发提案当成ETH价格利好。今天查看以太坊Geth官方仓库，10月26日新开的PR #36019拟修正一种RPC接口行为：单条“通知”请求超过时限时，节点当前可能回传超时错误；按JSON-RPC 2.0规范，通知即使失败也不应收到响应。提案希望保留内部超时记录和取消处理，同时抑制这类多余回包，普通带请求编号的调用仍按原方式返回超时。项目页面显示它仍为Open，要求代码所有者审查，也写明尚未部署。不能把它说成以太坊主网故障、资金被盗或Gas下降。

这件事的市场意义在于基础设施质量，而非币的即时供需。钱包、交易机器人和数据服务会通过RPC读取或发送请求。若应用把不该出现的通知响应当成真正的用户调用结果，可能产生报警噪声或重试逻辑混乱；修复后有望让接口行为更可预测。但用户资金安全还取决于签名、节点配置和应用自身校验。一个未合并的RPC补丁不会直接改变区块容量、手续费销毁和质押收益。我会盯代码审查、合并、正式版本发布与运营方升级，再评估它是否真改善服务稳定性。

价格端也需要诚实。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2327.40美元，UTC当日开盘2326.62，滚动24小时高2361.91、低2290.71。接近开盘的价格无法支持“提案推动ETH上涨”的叙事。Farside的10月23日ETH ETF表格仍有ETHV缺栏，因此表面合计不能被当成完整资金净流入。短线我看2335至2340美元能否收复，往上才看2360；下方先看2310，再看2290。若始终站不稳2340，或跌穿2290后反抽无力，偏多条件失效。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与；方向只考虑现货条件多单，单次仓位最多占总资金1.5%。入场必须同时满足ETH站上2340美元至少一小时、BTC没有急跌，且交易量不是单根尖峰。第一目标2360美元减半，第二目标2390美元减余仓；初始止损放在2308美元下方，触发就平仓。若入场后一天仍不能守住2335，或Geth提案被撤回、出现更严重的相反证据，也提前离场。当前只是未触发计划，不是已买入或已盈利。

Someone asked: How long does a transaction have to wait before it can be considered completely irreversible?
I usually answer this way: Bitcoin only has probabilistic finality. translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (in terms of execution),
and what you’ll do differently next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be amazed to discover that your losses
The same kinds of mistakes keep showing up in your trades—for example, immediately reversing direction after a stop-loss,
or always closing profitable trades too soon.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—review your trading records.

Can stablecoins be redeemed for fiat currency at any time? Canada’s draft rules make the answer clear: issuers generally have to begin redemption within 3 business days, fees can’t exceed 1%, and there’s no minimum redemption amount—even if you hold just a little, you can go directly to the issuer to get your money back.

On October 24, the Department of Finance Canada published draft Stablecoin Regulations in the Canada Gazette to implement the Stablecoin Act, passed this March. Here are the key points that matter directly to everyday people👇

🔹 1:1 reserves: At the end of each day, the market value of reserve assets must be at least equal to the face value of stablecoins in circulation; reserves can only consist of high-quality liquid assets, such as cash and short-term securities
🔹 Redemption timeline: Complete the redemption process within 3 business days of receiving a request (sell reserve assets and initiate the fiat transfer)
🔹 Fees capped at 1%, with at least 7 days’ notice on the issuer’s website before any fee increase
🔹 Issuers can’t pay holders interest or yield just for holding stablecoins; rewards for encouraging their use are allowed
🔹 Non-bank issuers must register with the Bank of Canada; financial institutions such as banks and credit unions are outside the scope of this law
🔹 Public consultation runs until December 23, with the rules expected to take effect alongside the Act in fall 2027—these are still draft rules, not yet in force

In plain English: in the future, if you buy, use, or redeem stablecoins in Canada, redemption timelines and fee caps will be set out in law. Issuers also won’t be able to compete with bank deposits by offering “interest for holding.” For stablecoin holders, that means an extra layer of redemption protection; for projects looking to issue stablecoins, it means a higher compliance bar.

Do you think 3 business days and a 1% fee cap are fair for everyday users?

content:
稳定币能不能随时兑回法币？加拿大草案把答案写死了：发行方一般要在 3 个工作日内启动兑付，手续费最高不能超过 1%，而且没有最低赎回门槛——手里哪怕只有一点，也能直接找发行方要回钱。

加拿大财政部 10 月 24 日在《加拿大公报》挂出了《稳定币条例》草案，用来落实今年 3 月通过的《稳定币法》。核心几条，跟普通人直接相关👇

🔹 1:1 储备：每天结束时，储备资产市值至少要等于流通面值；只能放现金、短债等高质量流动资产
🔹 赎回时效：接到申请后 3 个工作日内完成兑回流程（卖出储备并启动法币转账）
🔹 手续费封顶 1%，且涨价前至少在官网公示 7 天
🔹 禁止向持有人支付「躺着拿」的利息或收益；鼓励使用的交易奖励可以有
🔹 非银行发行方须向加拿大央行登记；银行、信用社等金融机构不在本法范围内
🔹 意见征集至 12 月 23 日，目标 2027 年秋季与法案同步生效——现在还是草案，不是已生效的规矩

说白了：以后在加拿大买、用、兑稳定币，兑回窗口和费用上限会被写进法规，发行方也不能再靠「持币生息」跟银行存款抢客。对持币人是多了一层兑付保障，对想发币的项目则是合规门槛抬高了。

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | The Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Exactly as They Are Today
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every principle, so I wrote them down and stuck them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position. Never average down.
4. After three consecutive losing trades, stop trading for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
5. Withdraw part of your profits. What you take out is money; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

That’s all five rules, and not one is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it’s that their execution falls apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

SK hynix reportedly plans 16 trillion won special dividend, funded by gains from Kioxia stake sale

Background: SK hynix is a global leader in memory chips and a key supplier of high-bandwidth memory for artificial intelligence. Its capital allocation has long been a market focus. In August, the company announced a quarterly dividend of 375 won per share and pledged to provide more details on shareholder returns in the third quarter, fueling expectations of additional payouts.

Key facts: On October 26, South Korea’s Dong-A Ilbo, citing investment banking sources, reported that SK hynix plans to pay a special dividend of around 16 trillion won. The company is expected to announce it alongside its third-quarter results on Wednesday. Most of the funds would come from profits made by selling its stake in Japanese memory chipmaker Kioxia. SK hynix previously reduced its Kioxia holdings, with market estimates putting the proceeds at around 20 trillion won; the planned dividend would amount to roughly 80% of those gains. The company still holds about 14% of Kioxia. Important caveat: Bloomberg, citing regulatory filings, reported that the company is studying various shareholder-return options and has not yet decided whether to pay a special dividend. The final outcome will depend on an official announcement.

Analysis: First, this special dividend would come from a one-off gain on the disposal of an equity stake, rather than representing a regular distribution of operating cash flow; it is therefore more akin to a one-time realization of gains. Second, returning 80% of the disposal proceeds to shareholders suggests management is leaning notably toward shareholder returns over capital expenditure. Third, according to information disclosed in August, the company had about 88 trillion won in cash and cash equivalents and around 69.4 trillion won in net cash reserves at the end of the second quarter, providing a financial cushion for the payout. These are historical figures, and the latest position awaits confirmation in the third-quarter report. Fourth, U.S. regulatory filings show that two leveraged ETFs tracking SK hynix have decided to delist and liquidate, pointing to a concurrent contraction in the market for leveraged investment products.

Potential impact on crypto markets (speculative analysis): SK hynix is a bellwether for the AI hardware supply chain. Its willingness to pay a large dividend indirectly reflects management’s confidence in memory market conditions and demand for AI memory. Signals of this kind typically reinforce the narrative of strength in AI infrastructure, while sentiment around AI-themed tokens often moves in tandem with the health of the technology supply chain, potentially providing a short-term sentiment catalyst. Another possible channel is hardware costs: rising memory prices could increase the cost of computing equipment and potentially affect the economics of deploying some computing networks. This is only a logical inference and is not currently supported by data. In addition, generous shareholder returns from a semiconductor giant may bolster risk appetite in the technology sector, which has historically been correlated with sentiment in crypto markets.

Editorial view: The levels of certainty surrounding this news are clearly differentiated: the dividend report comes from media sources, while the company says it is still studying options. Wednesday’s earnings announcement is the key moment for confirmation. For crypto readers, rather than trading around a single rumor in the short term, it is more useful to treat it as a reference point for gauging the strength of the AI narrative. If the third-quarter report confirms both robust memory market conditions and substantial shareholder returns, sentiment support for related assets would be on firmer footing; if the plan is scaled back or abandoned, it would be another reminder that rumors and official announcements are not the same.

content:
传SK海力士拟派16万亿韩元特别股息 资金源自减持铠侠收益

事件背景：SK海力士是全球存储芯片龙头，也是人工智能高带宽内存的核心供应商，其资本运作历来是市场焦点。今年8月公司已宣布每股375韩元的季度分红，并承诺于第三季度公布更多股东回报细节，市场对追加回报的预期持续升温。

核心事实：10月26日，据韩国《东亚日报》援引投行消息，SK海力士计划派发约16万亿韩元的特别股息，预计周三公布第三季度业绩时一并宣布，资金来自出售日本存储芯片公司铠侠股权所获利润的大部分。此前公司减持铠侠股份，市场估算获利约20万亿韩元，拟派息金额约相当于该利润的八成；目前公司仍持有铠侠约14%权益。需要强调：彭博援引监管文件称，公司正研究多种股东回报方案，尚未决定是否派发特别股息，最终以官方公告为准。

逻辑拆解：其一，这笔特别股息源于一次性股权处置收益，而非经营性现金流的常态分配，性质上更接近落袋式回报；其二，将处置获利的八成回馈股东，显示管理层在资本开支与股东回报之间明显向后者倾斜；其三，据8月披露，公司二季度末现金及等价物约88万亿韩元、净现金储备约69.4万亿韩元，回报有家底支撑，此为既往数据，最新状况待三季报验证；其四，美国监管文件显示，两只以SK海力士为标的的杠杆ETF已决定退市清盘，场内杠杆工具生态同步收缩。

加密市场影响路径（以下为推断性分析）：SK海力士是人工智能硬件链的晴雨表，敢于大额派息间接折射管理层对存储景气与人工智能内存需求的信心，这类信号通常强化人工智能基础设施景气叙事，而人工智能概念代币板块情绪常与科技产业链景气度同频，短期或形成情绪面催化。另一路径是硬件成本：存储涨价会推高算力设备成本，或影响部分算力网络的部署经济性，该路径仅为逻辑推演，暂无数据验证。此外，半导体巨头慷慨回报有助科技板块风险偏好，后者与加密市场情绪存在历史相关性。

编辑判断：本条消息确定性分层清晰，派息传闻来自媒体援引，公司口径仍是方案研究中，周三业绩会才是关键验证节点。对加密读者而言，与其围绕单条传闻进行短期博弈，不如将其视为观察人工智能叙事强度的参照坐标：若三季报确认存储高景气与大额回报并行，相关资产的情绪支撑将更扎实；若方案缩水或落空，则再次提示传闻与官宣之间始终有距离。

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十月二十六日，以太坊现报价二千三百二十八点三零美元，过去二十四小时下跌百分之零点七一。盘中最低触及二千三百零四点四四美元，随后反弹至二千三百三十五美元附近。从最近五根小时K线来看，价格经历了先跌后涨的震荡走势，最后一根K线收于二千三百三十四点二六美元，成交量四百一十点二一枚ETH，较前一根K线的一万二千七百零九枚大幅缩量，说明反弹力度有限。

布林带数据显示，上轨在二千三百六十五点五零美元，中轨在二千三百三十三点二零美元，下轨在二千三百零零点九零美元。当前价格在中轨和下轨之间窄幅波动，波动区间明显收窄。标准差从零上一小时的三点二四扩大至五点五四，预示波动率即将上升，市场可能迎来方向性突破。超级趋势指标阻力位在二千三百六十三点一五美元，价格远低于该水平，中期趋势偏空格局未变。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现典型的空头排列。七周期均线二千三百二十一点六四美元低于二十五周期均线二千三百三十三点零九美元，更低于九十九周期均线二千三百六十九点零一美元。指数移动平均线同样如此，七周期EMA二千三百二十五点一五美元低于二十五周期EMA二千三百三十二点五三美元和九十九周期EMA二千三百六十五点七九美元。短中长期均线全面压制，反弹空间受到限制。

MACD指标出现边际改善。MACD线从零上一小时的负八点零八回升至负六点七三，信号线从零上一小时的负七点九三变化至负七点六九，柱状图从零上一小时的负零点一六转为正零点九五，这是MACD柱状图由负转正的关键信号，表明短期空头动能开始衰竭。但MACD线仍处于零轴下方，整体弱势格局尚未扭转。

RSI六周期从零上一小时的五十一点八零上升至六十一零点二零，进入中性偏强区域。十二周期RSI为五十一六点三八，二十四周期RSI为四十七点三一，不同周期的RSI出现分化，说明短线反弹力度较强但中线仍偏弱。KDJ指标中K值六十八点八五、D值五十二点八八、J值一百零八点八零，J值突破一百进入超买区域，短线存在回调需求。

威廉指标从零上一小时的负四十八点一六快速下降至负三十一点一七，确认短线超买。ATR十四周期维持在十七点五八美元，波动率处于正常水平。综合因子统计显示十五个因子中五个看多、九个看空、一个中性，空头因子占比百分之六十。综合指标信号为看空，历史胜率为百分之七十四点四二，其中做空信号胜率为百分之七十四点四二。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场正经历一轮剧烈的去杠杆过程。过去三周内，以太坊累计下跌约百分之十五，市值蒸发约五百四十亿美元。ETH现货ETF连续录得大规模赎回，单周净流出超过二点二亿美元，其中贝莱德的ETHA基金赎回了约九万六千八百二十七枚ETH，机构资金的持续撤离给市场带来沉重压力。

链上数据同样不容乐观。与以太坊基金会关联的钱包通过Cowswap抛售了二千七百八十五枚ETH，同时休眠的ICO鲸鱼将一千五百枚ETH转入交易所，现货市场面临直接的抛压。此外，Glamsterdam测试网因EIP八零三七 gas缺陷而暂停，网络升级时间线面临不确定性，进一步打击了市场信心。

不过也有值得关注的潜在底部信号。分析师Darkfost指出，今年七月曾出现类似的未平仓合约崩溃，随后以太坊反弹了百分之三十二。当前质押率创下百分之三十六的历史新高，长期持有者的锁仓意愿强烈，这在一定程度上限制了下行空间。如果ETF赎回潮放缓且链上抛压减轻，以太坊有望在当前区域构筑底部。但短期内，美联储利率决议仍是最大的不确定性因素，投资者需保持谨慎。

How long does a transaction have to wait before it can no longer be reversed?
Ethereum blocks usually become “finalized” after two epochs (about 12.8 minutes).
An attacker who reverses an Ethereum block that has already been finalized would have at least one-third of their staked ETH slashed.
The most important thing to remember when managing positions: deposits and withdrawals across different chains have different finality speeds, so a delay in receiving funds doesn’t necessarily mean something has gone wrong.

📰 We just said cloud giants were set to burn through cash. Now that earnings are out, will the results satisfy institutional investors—or send Wall Street’s blood pressure soaring?

Microsoft and Google parent Alphabet are due to report Q3 earnings next Wednesday. The two tech giants are rapidly expanding their cloud businesses, but the cost of investment is climbing too. Wall Street wants to know: can all this spending really pay off? Could investment keep outpacing returns indefinitely?

Why does this matter?
Put simply, cloud computing is now the lifeblood of tech stocks, but expanding too aggressively can be like running full tilt into a wall. Alphabet and Microsoft are both major cloud providers, and their earnings reports directly reflect market confidence in this high-growth sector. If they take too long to turn a profit, other companies following their lead may tighten their purse strings too. And with markets now somewhat sensitive to interest rates, any signs of debt-related pressure in these companies’ earnings could make investors more inclined to head for the exits.

Potential market impact
If the earnings reports show that cloud profitability is continuing to improve, that could lift the broader tech sector and support sentiment around BTC and ETH. More importantly, if the tech giants say investment is still accelerating and results are unlikely to show up in the short term, it could spark concerns that tech stock valuations are too high. If that sentiment spills over into crypto markets, investors may reassess the risks of growth stocks. For now, however, BTC and ETH’s own fundamentals matter more than this news, so the impact is likely to be mostly short-term sentiment.

How to think about it
Cloud growth is a long-term trend, but short-term pressure on profitability is a real concern. If the earnings reports show improving margins, that could signal that risk appetite for tech stocks remains strong, which would be positive for crypto markets. But if companies continue to emphasize heavy investment with little payoff, investors may become more cautious. ETH node subscription cache fix awaits review | Reduces server-side retention, not gas | Awaiting confirmation near $2,330

My stance is to remain on the sidelines with a small position size. PR #36011 in the official Ethereum Geth repository is still marked Open. It addresses notifications temporarily buffered when an RPC subscription starts: even after notifications have been sent successfully, the original buffer may continue holding those messages and their contents for as long as the subscription handler remains active. The contributor proposes clearing the buffer after successful delivery and has run local regression tests using 1, 10, and 100 startup notifications. The author reports that, across six local comparisons using 64 KiB log payloads, active notifiers retained references to approximately 64 KiB, 640 KiB, and 6.25 MiB of content before the fix, respectively, and retained none afterward. This is not peak memory data for a full node, nor can it be directly converted into throughput. The code is currently awaiting review; it should not be described as deployed, let alone as a reduction in mainnet gas fees.

Why should traders care? Many wallets, dashboards, and trading systems use node subscriptions to receive blocks or logs. If a long-running service continually retains messages that have already been sent, it can increase resource-management pressure; reducing this retention could potentially improve operational stability at the engineering level. It does not change ETH issuance, staking rewards, or block capacity, and there is no evidence that it is driving current price movements. If a trading interface lags or disconnects, first check node status and multiple data sources. Don’t mistake the availability of a single RPC service for whether the entire network has stopped. At the project level, the next things to watch are code review, merging, a release, and independent verification under different workloads.

Nor should a conclusion about fund flows be based on a single data point. Farside’s ETH ETF table shows combined outflows of about $110.6 million on October 22. The ETHV column in the October 23 table is still blank, so the displayed total of $4.4 million cannot be treated as the final net inflow for all products, much less used to infer fresh weekend inflows. At the time of writing, the latest Kraken ETH/USD trade was around $2,328.80; today’s UTC open was $2,326.62, with a high of $2,335.20 and a low of $2,290.71. Price is only slightly above the open and has not convincingly broken out of the intraday range. There is also no verifiable causal link to the subscription-cache proposal. The Federal Reserve’s website lists an October 27–28 policy meeting; plans should account for the risk of contracting liquidity and wider stop-loss slippage as the decision approaches.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and keep only a conditional spot-long setup in mind. First, I’d look for price to hold above $2,335–$2,340 on rising volume. Only if a pullback holds above $2,330 would I take a starter position with 2% of total capital. The first target is $2,362; I’d take half off there and let the remainder run toward $2,385. After entry, if price falls back below $2,315, I’d cut the position in half. I’d exit fully if it breaks below $2,290 or major macro news invalidates the thesis. The maximum planned loss on the trade is 0.3% of total capital, and I would not use leverage. If price first breaks below $2,290 without quickly reclaiming it, I’d cancel the entry, stay in cash, and wait for a new daily-chart structure. This view would be invalidated if price loses the bottom of the range, or if complete ETF data and risk appetite both turn notably weaker. A plan that has not been triggered is not a trade, and certainly not a profit. Discipline comes first; the software development is background information only.

#ETH

ETH节点订阅缓存修复待审｜减轻服务端滞留而非降Gas｜2330美元附近等确认

我的态度是继续轻仓观望。以太坊Geth官方仓库的PR #36011仍显示Open，针对RPC订阅启动时暂存的通知：通知已成功发送后，原缓冲区仍可能在订阅处理器存活期间持有这些消息及其内容。提交者拟在成功发出后清空缓冲，并用1、10、100条启动通知做了本地回归测试。作者报告，在64KiB日志负载的六组本地对比中，修复前活动通知器分别保留约64KiB、640KiB和6.25MiB的内容引用，修复后不再保留；这不是全节点峰值内存数据，也不能直接换算成吞吐量。它目前是待评审代码，不能写成已部署、更不能写成主网Gas下调。

为什么值得交易者关注？许多钱包、数据看板和交易系统通过节点订阅区块或日志。长期运行的服务如果持续保留已发送消息，会增加资源管理压力；减少滞留有利于运营稳定性，这是工程层面的潜在价值。它并不会改变ETH发行、质押收益或区块容量，也没有证据显示现价波动由此引起。若一个交易界面延迟或断流，先核对节点状态与多家数据源，别把单个RPC服务的可用性当成整个网络是否停止。项目层面后续要看代码审阅、合并、发行版本以及不同负载下的独立验证。

资金面也不能用单项数据下结论。Farside的ETH ETF表显示10月22日合计约流出1.106亿美元；23日表里ETHV一栏仍是缺值，因此4.4百万美元的显示合计不能当成全体产品的最终净流入，更不能推断周末的新资金。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD最近成交约2328.80美元，今日UTC开2326.62，高2335.20、低2290.71。价格仅略高于开盘，尚未有效摆脱日内区间；与订阅缓存提案之间也没有可验证的因果关系。美联储官网列出10月27至28日议息会议，临近决议时流动性收缩、止损滑点放大的风险要算进计划。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向只保留条件式现货多单。先看2335至2340是否放量站稳，回踩2330不破才拿总资金的2%试仓；第一目标2362，达到后减一半，余仓看2385。进场后若跌回2315先缩半仓，跌破2290或重大宏观消息使原假设失效就全部平仓；单笔计划亏损上限为总资金0.3%，不使用杠杆。若先跌破2290而没有快速收复，我会取消入场、保持现金，等新的日线结构。这个判断的推翻条件是价格失守区间下沿或ETF完整数据与风险偏好明显转弱；未触发的方案不算成交，更不能写成收益。优先守纪律，软件进展只作背景信息。

Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day adds up to 12 times your money over 250 trading days in a year; earning a steady 10% each month
adds up to 30 times your money over three years. It doesn’t sound exciting, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. You have to wait for the market, but discipline is up to you. Don’t make your goal
“double my money this week.” Make it “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the first goal comes from the market,
while the ability to achieve the second is yours. The market opens every day, but only those who preserve their capital get to keep playing.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What does the candle you FOMO into usually look like?
translatedData.subTitle:
The price shoots up in a huge green candle, everyone in the group chat is yelling “Go, go, go!” and your hand slips as you chase in—only to end up buying at
the top. This scenario plays out every day.

Take a good look at that huge green candle that made your heart race: it’s what people who are already fully invested hope you’ll buy into
it. Chasing after a sharp, high-volume rally is essentially providing liquidity to those who were already holding.

A simple but effective trick: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candles. If the pullback comes on declining volume and stabilizes,
you’ll get a better entry; if it drops straight back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself an expensive lesson. The market will always
give you a second chance, but it won’t give you a second bankroll.

title: 周一傍晚：跌幅收窄了，不等于方向定了
subTitle:
周一傍晚：跌幅收窄了，不等于方向定了

周一上海傍晚，公开行情里加密白天更像「磨完再磨」：BTC 约 8.02 万（近 24 小时约 -0.2%），白天高点约 8.10 万、低点约 7.94 万——早盘那点回吐大半收窄了，但并没有真正离开 8 万整数位附近的横盘带。ETH 约 2325（约 -0.5%），仍略弱于大饼；SOL 约 101（约 +0.1%）小幅翻红，BNB 约 736（约 -0.4%），XRP 约 1.29（约 -0.8%）。结构还是「大饼扛着、高 beta 参差」，不是全面风险偏好开机。

对照今早：早盘更软一点，傍晚跌幅收窄——这通常只说明「卖压没继续加码」，不自动等于「买盘已经接管」。流动性回来以后，先暴露的仍是分化，不是趋势。

同一时段美股期货大致微红（ES 约 7684、NQ 约 2.92 万），油价 WTI 仍在约 $101 附近回吐周五高位后的区间；今晚现金盘（约 21:30 上海时间）才是本周第一个真正的共振检验。本周后面还有 FOMC 与大厂财报，波动率大概率会被抬起来。

我个人怎么读这个周一傍晚（仅观察，非投资建议）：

1. 别把「24h 跌幅从约 -1% 收到接近平盘」读成企稳确认——整数位附近反复，最常见的是等宏观定调，而不是自己走出独立趋势。
2. 今晚先看美股现金盘量能与高 beta（纳指）跟不跟；币圈跟得上算共振，跟不上更像脱钩噪音。
3. 顺序我仍坚持：油价/美债是否同向 → 美股开盘方向 → 再回头看 BTC 8 万是支撑还是反复试探。倒过来用白天币价推美股，容易被磨盘带节奏。

你怎么看：今晚开盘后，更像「白天磨底后的跟随反弹」，还是「财报/FOMC 周前继续观望」？评论区聊聊。

First, let’s look at the weekly chart. It closed with a small red candle and a long upper wick, showing significant overhead pressure. After three consecutive weeks of declines, the Three Black Crows pattern suggests that this week may still be challenging.

The daily chart is fairly clear: Bitcoin’s recent pullback has mostly followed the channel of a rising flag pattern. The lower boundary has now moved down to around 78,800, which could be where Bitcoin makes its next wick low. The MACD has crossed below the zero line, suggesting weakness may persist in the short term.

However, a rising flag is a bullish continuation pattern. Bitcoin could regain strength once it breaks above the upper boundary, currently around 84,000. A breakout above the resistance zone between 84,000 and 85,200 could therefore serve as a reference for a relatively conservative entry point.

The flag’s lower-boundary support now overlaps with the 78,600–76,000 support zone, and the previous low at 74,967 is also nearby.
